name: site-shot-mcp
description: Website screenshot API for AI agents: the Site-Shot MCP server lets Claude, Cursor and other agents capture web pages in real Chromium (full-page, country proxies on paid plans, automatic ad & cookie-banner removal).

scripts.check: node --check src/server.js && node --check src/index.js && node --check src/image-tiles.js && node --check src/uds-worker.js
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run smoke && npm run test:plugin && npm run test:remote && npm run test:stdio
scripts.validate:plugin: claude plugin validate --strict . && claude plugin validate --strict plugins/site-shot
